item.title: Horns of Deliverance
item.description:
Title: Horns of Deliverance
Genre: Action , Indie , Early Access
Developer: schemesmith
Publisher: schemesmith
Release Date: Oct 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 12, 2026




About This Game

YOU HAVE A BRAINCHIP IN YOUR HEAD

Horns of Deliverance is a fast paced action roguelike with grounded gunplay. Enjoy the benefits of a brainchip with easy to view health diagnostics and alerts.

YOUR BRAINCHIP IS TRYING TO KILL YOU

Someone flipped the switch and now your brainchip is trying to kill you. Consume psychoactive substances to interfere with your brainchip and stay in control long enough to make it to the end.

FEATURES:

  • Procedural Level Generation

  • Varied Enemies

  • Psychoactive Substances With Crazy Effects

  • Upgrade Equipment Between Levels

  • Behold Divine Providence

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Contains blood, violence, psychoactive substance use, and themes of mental illness.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

Linux

    Minimum:
    • OS: SteamOS or similar
    • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: 8 RDNA 2 CUs, 1.6GHz

item.title: Haunted Heist
item.description:
Title: Haunted Heist
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: autotroph games
Publisher: autotroph games
Release Date: Oct 12, 2026




About This Game


OVERVIEW

Haunted Heist is a round-based asymmetrical party game for 3–8 players. A team of Heisters works together to retrieve gems scattered throughout a procedurally generated mansion—while a rival team of Tricksters haunts the halls, sabotaging their every move.

The Heisters must collect gems and return them to their safe room before time runs out. If they succeed, they win. If the timer expires, or they’re wiped out by the Tricksters’ antics and attacks, the mansion claims another crew.

THE HEISTERS

Heisters rely on teamwork, tools, and proximity chat to survive the mansion’s dangers. Armed with a handgun, flashlight, flares, and defibrillators, they must manage their battery, conserve ammo, and stay close to one another to avoid being picked off.

Powerups can restore resources, enhance equipment, or help navigate its winding halls. Smart coordination and steady nerves are essential—because the Tricksters are always watching.

THE TRICKSTERS

Tricksters thrive in the dark, using fear, deception, and sudden violence to keep the Heisters off-balance. Their arsenal includes night vision, player muting, voice swapping, disguises, invisibility, voice modulation, and the ability to strike from the shadows before vanishing again.

Each ability runs on cooldowns, rewarding clever timing and psychological pressure. A skilled Trickster mixes mind games with lethal ambushes, becoming an unpredictable and genuinely unsettling force of chaos.

FEATURES

  • Asymmetrical PvP Mayhem – Heisters work together to gather gems while Tricksters sabotage, deceive, and hunt them through a haunted mansion.

  • 3–8 Player Party Chaos – Perfect for friends, stream nights, and community games with flexible team sizes.

  • Procedurally Generated Mansions – Every round takes place in a new layout with fresh routes and hiding spots.

  • Tense Co-op Survival – Heisters must conserve batteries, stick together, and communicate through proximity chat to stay alive.

  • Unhinged Trickster Abilities – Invisibility, disguises, night vision, voice swapping, muting, ambush attacks, and more—each with cooldowns that reward clever timing.

  • Combat & Tools for Heisters – Utilize handguns, flashlights, flares, and defibrillators while scrounging for powerups that enhance your gear.

  • Psychological Warfare – Tricksters can harass, mislead, and terrify their opponents, turning every hallway into a potential trap.

  • Fast, Replayable Rounds – Quick matches encourage experimentation, laughs, and revenge rematches.

  • Built for Parties – High chaos, proximity chat, and emergent storytelling create highlight-worthy moments every session.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

There is cartoon violence and the primary weapon is a gun.



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

item.title: The Last Flight
item.description:
Title: The Last Flight
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Christor
Publisher: Christor
Release Date: Oct 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 12, 2026




About This Game

🌍 The world once soared through the skies on wings of steel… until everything changed.

When disaster struck, the lucky ones bought property on remote islands, now the last remaining safe havens. Humanity clings to survival, scattered and struggling, with fragile network infrastructure barely held together by a few.

But life... goes on. Even in ruin.

✈️ You’ve found an abandoned plane

It's old. It's broken. But it’s yours. Scavenge the world for parts. Rebuild it . Fly between islands... or maybe beyond .

💻 In a world where real interaction is rare, the internet is your lifeline

Slow? Yes. Fragile? Definitely. But essential.
Your connection to the world is digital and vital:

  • Order plane parts online

  • Chat with clients and maybe friends

  • Browse post-apocalyptic websites

  • Manage your email

  • Pay your internet bills… if you want to stay connected

🧠 Monitor your needs and mental state

Stay sharp. Stay sober. Flying under the influence isn't just reckless, it's deadly.

👥 And the past?

It wasn’t as peaceful as you remember. Dark memories linger, haunting your every step. You’ll have to decide: run from them or face them.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Visual References



System Requirements

Windows

    • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 / Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2 GB VRAM, DirectX 11)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4–6 GB VRAM)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space

item.title: Battleplan
item.description:
Title: Battleplan
Genre: Strategy
Developer: Foolish Mortals Games Inc.
Publisher: Slitherine Ltd.
Franchise: Battleplan
Release Date: Oct 12, 2026




About This Game

Take command of entire divisions and fight in some of the war's largest battles. Battleplan is a unique real-time strategy game that simulates massive month-long battles with hundreds of thousands of troops second by second, day by day. You give high-level orders, then watch your officers and companies carry them out autonomously.

Create elaborate plans

Create elaborate, multi-step and multi-unit plans intuitively by directly drawing on the map. Employ varied tactics such as defence in depth, counterattacks, planned withdrawals and more. Perform preparatory bombardments before large set-piece attacks, then split the division to capture multiple objectives.

Realistic army

Each division is realistically modeled with headquarters, regiments, battalions and companies. Watch your infantry, tanks, engineers, anti-tank guns, artillery and scouts work together and perform tasks autonomously. Customize the entire chain of command and order of battle of your entire army. Combine divisions into corps, or split units down to companies. Requisition and upgrade units throughout the campaign. Hire and fire officers for your divisions. Listen to their advice - or don't! Keep your officers alive so they gain veterancy (and quirks).

Massive battlefields

Fight across thousands of kilometers modeled using real-world geographic data. Each road, town, forest and swamp is exactly where they are in real-life. Place your artillery on the high-ground by examining real-world elevation maps.

Real-time missions

Each mission is simulated second-by-second, allowing you to pause, play in real-time or fast-forward at will. Mission lengths range from one week to a month.

Master logistics

Starve the enemy by cutting their supply lines. Fuel your advance by capturing supply depots. Pull back when your units run low on supplies. Supply is realistically simulated, with terrain dictating supply flow.

Win the war

Play 10+ massive historical battles set on World War II specifically in the Western Front, from 1944 onward. Upgrade your divisions with new attachments and promote officers. Let wounded divisions rest and recuperate. Gain powerful air support assets such recon, fighter-bomber and heavy bomber aircraft.

Relive history

Learn real-world history by examining geo-tagged historical photos and videos where they were taken in real-life.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: 64-bit Windows 11 / 10
    • Processor: Intel Celeron G4920 (Legacy: i3-2100) , AMD Athlon 200GE
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT 1030 (Legacy: Nvidia GeForce GTS 450), AMD Radeon RX 460 (Legacy: ATI Radeon HD 5570)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 8 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
    Recommended:
    • OS: 64-bit Windows 11 / 10
    • Processor: 4 cores Intel | AMD CPU (Intel i3-8100, AMD Ryzen 3 1200)
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1040 3 GB (Legacy: Nvidia Geforce GTX 780), AMD Radeon RX 580 (Legacy: AMD Radeon R9 290X)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 8 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

item.title: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
item.description:
Title: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
Genre: Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Proto Division
Publisher: Rock Paper Publisher
Release Date: Oct 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 12, 2026




About This Game

Serve drinks while your bar falls apart.

Barfender is a chaotic co-op bar sim where fights break out, drinks spill, and you’re still trying to keep orders moving.

  • Customers get drunk, impatient, and start fights

  • Orders pile up faster than you can handle

  • Glasses shatter and the mess keeps spreading

  • Unwanted guests wander in, thieves grab what they can

Serve drinks, clean disasters, stop fights, and hold the bar together before it completely collapses.

Serve Under Pressure

Pour beers, shake cocktails, fake a smile, and mop up puke while the night spirals out of control.

Online Co-op Chaos

Serve customers together with friends. Maybe don’t smash a beer mug into your teammate’s face… or do!

Problematic Customers

Polite regulars, rowdy drunks, hopeless romantics, bar brawlers. Everyone here has a personality.

Design The Bar Which You'll Probably Ruin Later

Style your bar to perfection. Then pray the crowd doesn’t tear it apart.

Unlock Drinks, Tools, and Upgrades

Craft better drinks. Expand the bar. Lead your crew from a scrappy old bar to a thriving nightlife empire.

Bar Games and Activities

Blow off steam with darts, pool, retro arcade machines, and a wild rodeo bull.

Booze and Bad Decisions

Keep tempers down before it turns into a full-blown bar fight... or your wallet pays the price.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI tools were used only in the narration / voice acting workflow, with consent from the voice artist. Also AI-generated content used for Steam capsules.

All visual assets, gameplay content, and core creative work are created by our team and external artists."



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS
